main_measure.name: mean per-case gain (forecast/10) x (2-bar return - m) on Sunday bars with forecast < 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean gain > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passes; reject: mean gain < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: excess 2-bar return of large-|forecast| half minus small-|forecast| half (< 0 passes)

decided_by: t >= 2 but the supporting check fails, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: Cases are Sunday-stamped (UTC) bars with forecast < 0 that have close[t+2] in the same window; m per coin from the 0,2,4,... grid of each window pooled over all windows; the median split puts |forecast| above the median in the large half and the rest in the small half; the plan's 'fewer than 100 cases' minimum is reported as not observable.
